title: Report to Dotson

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: You return! Did you ferret out needles of truth from the haystack of mendacity?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You return! Did you ferret out needles of truth from the haystack of mendacity?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: CORA’s tears! Who?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CORA’s tears! Who?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: This is terrible. You probed the suspects?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is terrible. You probed the suspects?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: And they revealed nothing? Calamity!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And they revealed nothing? Calamity!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: No, no. Without the guiding star of truth, the I.M.P.U.N.E is useless. I will destroy it. Along with my dreams of a fair and just society.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, no. Without the guiding star of truth, the I.M.P.U.N.E is useless. I will destroy it. Along with my dreams of a fair and just society.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Is it? I would rather merge with the Nets than remain tethered to this wretched pit of scum and felony. Goodbye, cruel city. You have defeated Dotson.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it? I would rather merge with the Nets than remain tethered to this wretched pit of scum and felony. Goodbye, cruel city. You have defeated Dotson.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: It was? But why did you not say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was? But why did you not say?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: And to think I almost failed! But this means my suspicions about Razlo were correct? I am not a hopeless sleuth?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And to think I almost failed! But this means my suspicions about Razlo were correct? I am not a hopeless sleuth?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: A bribe! Fascinating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A bribe! Fascinating.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: On the contrary! My suspicions about both Razlo and your own perfidious nature have been confirmed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On the contrary! My suspicions about both Razlo and your own perfidious nature have been confirmed.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Your methods are unorthodox but effective. Here, may it guide you through this dark and grubby world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your methods are unorthodox but effective. Here, may it guide you through this dark and grubby world.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: CORA’s tears! My logic array suggests an 87% probability of accuracy! The culprit is indubitably Razlo!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CORA’s tears! My logic array suggests an 87% probability of accuracy! The culprit is indubitably Razlo!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: If you wait but a moment I will run your conclusion through my logic array to calculate the likelihood of your deduction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you wait but a moment I will run your conclusion through my logic array to calculate the likelihood of your deduction.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Calamity! My logic array suggests a slim 8% probability of accuracy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calamity! My logic array suggests a slim 8% probability of accuracy!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: It means you are wrong my friend! And that the recipe pilferer remains unknown!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It means you are wrong my friend! And that the recipe pilferer remains unknown!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: No, no. If you do not carry the guiding star of truth within you, the I.M.P.U.N.E is useless.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, no. If you do not carry the guiding star of truth within you, the I.M.P.U.N.E is useless.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: You did! Badly! Once again, it is up to Dotson to save the day. ALONE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You did! Badly! Once again, it is up to Dotson to save the day. ALONE.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know who did it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know who did it.

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know who did it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Razlo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Razlo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ma Gomba.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ma Gomba.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Calhoun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calhoun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yep. Gave them all a good probing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yep. Gave them all a good probing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I still have the I.M.P.U.N.E license thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I still have the I.M.P.U.N.E license thing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, you were right about Razlo. It was him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, you were right about Razlo. It was him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, you were right about Razlo. It was him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, you were right about Razlo. It was him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't that a bit dramatic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't that a bit dramatic?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was... a test.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was... a test.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's paying me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's paying me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not angry?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not angry?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, can I have the license?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: So, can I have the license?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So, can I have the license?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I still have the license?

nodes.text: But I did the work!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I did the work!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So where's my reward?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So where's my reward?
